_description: Two-layer truth model for the SignalFoundry public site (HawkinsOperations portfolio). Defines layer precedence, public usage rules, and governance constraints for all agents editing site content.

layers.description: CI-verified, citation-backed claims. The sole source of truth for all public-facing and reviewer-facing claims.
layers.update_requirement: Human instruction + CI verification required to change any value

layers.description: Runtime pipeline telemetry from the last operator snapshot (2026-03-24). Informational only.
layers.public_use: Permitted only in clearly labeled telemetry widgets with explicit date qualification
layers.update_requirement: Operator snapshot update; never auto-promoted to authority

precedence_rule: If a value differs between verified_snapshot and live_operational_feed, public pages MUST display verified_snapshot. live_operational_feed may appear only in clearly labeled telemetry widgets and may never be presented as canonical, final, or reviewer-authoritative.
current_authority_date_rule: 2026-03-24 is the only current-facing authority date. All public claims must be qualified to this date or to a specific verified date.

snapshot_files.rule: Each snapshot must match current-authority.json at the time of creation. Snapshots are immutable once written.

public_claim_rules: All detection counts must match PROOF_PACK/VERIFIED_COUNTS.md exactly.
Pipeline runtime stats (cases, auto-close rate, escalations) require explicit date qualification (as of YYYY-MM-DD).
Forbidden claims: '200+ detections', 'Production SOC experience', any unqualified current-state claim from live_operational_feed.
Approximation markers (~, +) must not be stripped from claims that require them.
Clearance line must appear verbatim: 'Eligible to obtain clearance; willing to pursue sponsorship.'
Platform claims must include context qualifiers: (home lab), (lab environment).
No claim may be elevated in class without human review and explicit instruction.
agent_governance: Read this manifest before editing any site file that contains metrics, counts, or capability claims.
If a value is not in current-authority.json, it is not authority. Do not invent or interpolate.
Do not promote live_operational_feed values to public claims without creating a new verified_snapshot.
Any conflict between this manifest and site HTML is a drift violation - flag it, do not silently resolve.
This is a truth-system creation pass. Do not modify HTML layout or redesign page structure in this pass.
SignalFoundry is the canonical flagship system name. Use it consistently.
